 Luka Doncic final status for NBA Cup game vs. Warriors revealed 
 2026-10-30 11:22 
 Los Angeles Lakers superstar Luka Doncic is not listed on the team's injury report for their upcoming NBA Cup game against the Golden State Warriors, meaning he will most likely be available to play Friday night.
 Credit: Imagn Images - Scanpix 
 Credit Imagn Images - Scanpix 
 Credit Imagn Images - Scanpix

 The Los Angeles Lakers are set to have most of their key players available for the upcoming NBA Cup matchup on Friday night against the Golden State Warriors.

 After missing the last game against the LA Clippers due to back tightness, Lakers superstar Luka Doncic will return to the lineup tonight at Chase Center.
 Through four games, Doncic is averaging 36.0 points, 6.8 rebounds, and 8.3 assists while shooting 48.4% from the field and 39.6% from deep.
 Meanwhile, the Lakers have started the season strong with four wins in their first five games, coming off a big 103-87 win against the Clippers.
 Doncic leads near-full Lakers lineup into NBA Cup clash
 Along with Luka, all key players will be ready for the game against the Warriors, except for Adou Thiero, who is dealing with a left knee injury.
 There is also still a question mark regarding the status of Ziaire Williams, as he is currently listed as questionable for Friday.
 All other players, including Walker Kessler, who was dealing with a left finger splint, will be available.
